text: A playful line of over-the-counter medications that uses cheerful colors, lighthearted copy, and warm, friendly typography to ease the stress of dealing with minor illnesses. Product labels are conversational (“I’ve Got a Headache,” “I’m itchy”) to quickly guide customers to the right remedy and add a dash of humor to the experience.
